title: helianthella quinquenervis
intro: Helianthella quinquenervis, commonly known as five-nerve daisy, is a flowering plant species native to the western United States. It is used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and relieving digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Helianthella quinquenervis are attributed to its ability to inhibit histamine release and modulate the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
